meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 把 Claude 变成 5 个敌对评论员(怀疑者、验证者、研究员、架构师、创意者)的领队:它们互相挑刺攻击,经得起攻击的见解才被提炼,再交给 plan 代理写成可执行计划。开场喊 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!
howto.when: 你说“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等,或要敌对式交叉批判、严审盲点与过度设计的规划时触发。前置:开启 team-mode,并以 sisyphus 等主代理身份在主会话运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划一下这个项目
say.note: 触发 5 人对抗评论,产出一份可执行计划。

say.text: hpp:交叉批判这份方案,找出薄弱假设
say.note: 五名成员互相攻击,只剩站得住的见解。

say.text: 用 hostile planning 检查我的规划有没有过度设计
say.note: 质疑者与架构师会重点攻击多余复杂度。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes lead of 5 adversarial team members (skeptic, validator, researcher, architect, creative) that attack each other's findings. Surviving insights go to the plan agent for an executable plan. Opens with 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!'
howto.when_en: Trigger words: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', or requests for adversarial/hostile cross-critique planning. Requires team-mode enabled, running as lead-eligible agent (sisyphus) in the main session.

say_en.note: Starts 5-way adversarial debate; yields an executable plan.

say_en.text: hpp: cross-critique this plan and find weak assumptions.
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only defensible insights survive.

say_en.text: Use hostile planning to check my plan for over-engineering.
say_en.note: The skeptic and architect attack unnecessary complexity.
